_how: Manual fixes for news the data sources haven't caught up with. Each entry applies up to and including until_round, then is ignored. Fields: club (our code), pos, price, status (ok/doubtful/injured/out), pir (expected PIR per game, replaces the projection), why. The analyst adds entries from the user's news and removes expired ones.

Kenan Kamenjas.why: On loan from Dubai at Baskonia (the site still lists him at Dubai). R12 31' PIR 19, R13 30' PIR 25, R14 v Efes only 15' PIR 5: knee knock near half-time (helped off, returned; klix.ba, gasteizhoy.com) and Zaccharie Perrin's debut (11 pts 12 reb, PIR 20) took the big minutes. Faried and Santos still out. 14.5 = shared frontcourt with Perrin plus a small knee risk. 27 Nov: left out of Bosnia's game in Iceland (26 Nov) with the knee knock from R14 (tuzlalive.ba, times.ba); a week of rest before R15, status still to confirm.

Tyler Dorsey.why: Fit (35' and 17 pts for Greece v Georgia, 26 Nov) but Bartzokas says there is 'no timeline' for his return: a coach decision after his suspension (sportando, 26 Nov). 5.0 = about a coin flip to play, bench minutes if he does.

Evan Fournier.why: Lead creator with Montero out (31.7' L3). Small trim from the site's 14.8 for the chance Dorsey is back in the rotation.

Cory Joseph.why: 27.7' L3 with Montero, Dorsey and Konchar out; a Dorsey return would take guard minutes from him first. Site 10.4 -> 9.0.

Nikolaos Rogkavopoulos.why: Mitoglou tore his left hamstring for Greece v Georgia (26 Nov) and is out until at least the 11 Dec derby; Kalaitzakis has a sprained ankle (eurohoops.net/el, 27 Nov). Rogkavopoulos played 17' (PIR 15) in R14, the last game without a full frontcourt. 8.0 = about 16' at his career PIR per minute (site/model 6.1).
